root_idea.summary: The root denotes withholding or being sparing with something, especially something precious or highly valued.
root_idea.development: From withholding a prized thing, the lexical development extends to tenacious attachment, specially cherished persons, and related figurative uses; the Quranic ضَنِينٌ applies the idea to withholding revealed knowledge.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized citation form ضَنِينٌ, corresponding to the Quran-attested QAC lemma.

senses.definition: Withholding or miserly with respect to something precious; in the Quranic occurrence, one who does not withhold or conceal what has been revealed of the unseen.
senses.usage_conditions: Occurs in the negated construction وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ, meaning that he is not a tenacious concealer or withholder of revealed knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be niggardly, stingy, avaricious, or tenacious with respect to something; also to cling tenaciously to something or someone, including not relinquishing an abode.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Construes with بِهِ and may also take عَلَيْهِ or عَنْهُ; the clinging sense is attested in uses involving an abode or reciprocal association.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become niggardly, stingy, avaricious, or tenacious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII verb expressing the same withholding or tenacious disposition as ضَنَّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing highly esteemed, to which one is tenaciously attached.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to something valued and specially retained because of its worth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A specially cherished or chosen person, singled out as one's particular friend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be applied to a person specially appropriated or preferred from among one's companions; the plural is ضَنَائِنُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Niggardliness, tenaciousness, stinginess, or avarice, especially in a vehement degree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun for the disposition or condition of withholding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Courage, bravery, or strength of heart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct adjectival or nominal characterization of courageous disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A close, cohesive state in which a group has not dispersed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative use describing a group encountered while it remains gathered together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fresh or initial state of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative use applied to taking hold of something while it is still fresh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing held in high estimation, coveted, and competed for.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to an object of tenacious attachment because of its perceived value.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for a compound perfume known as الغالية; the word is also used for a kind of perfume or ben oil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical name associated with something jealously treasured.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for the well Zamzam.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name usage of the definite form.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers withholding, tenacious attachment, and related clinging constructions.
Pointer-only reference to the preceding entry.

cautions: A variant Quranic reading ظَنِينٍ is reported in the lexical discussion; this artifact treats the QAC-attested ضَنِينٍ form at 81:24 as the relevant form.
